en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, and Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah grant them both mercy, that they both said: We were told by Abdullah bin Ja’far al-Himyari, from Muhammed bin Hussain bin Abi’l-Khattab, that he said: We were told by Nadr bin Shu’ayb, from Abdul-Ghaffar al-Jazi, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he mentioned that
the weakened people are at (different) kinds, which some contradict the other, and that the one among the people of Qibla [1] who is not a Nasib, is a weakened individual.
